attributes.description: Flat string, number, boolean or null contact attributes.

ContactQuery.description:
Structured contact queries keep filter values in the JSON body, rather than
turning every combination into a new URL shape.  Every sortable column is
selected from a fixed allow-list; user input is always a bound value.

object_id.description: Object ID or slug, such as people.

values.description: List attribute keys; object values are not accepted here. Calculated fields cannot be supplied.
List-scoped values, including computed read-only formulas.

CrmNoteDocument.description: Validated inert TipTap document. Supports paragraphs, headings 1–3, lists, blockquotes, text, hard breaks, recordMention, and bold/italic/strike/code marks; no URLs, HTML, or arbitrary extensions.

CrmNoteWrite.description: Create requires a nonempty body or document. Rich content derives body and mentions. PATCH title alone preserves current content; body without content switches to plain text.

confirmation_name.description: Exact current name confirming permanent deletion.

due_at.description: ISO UTC datetime ending in Z
